title: Nourishing Silky Scottish Lamb Sunday Roast
description: A malty and silky Scottish lamb dish featuring salt and emulsification, served in a lacquerware bowl, perfect for a Sunday roast. This recipe is raw-friendly and light, making it a great option for a British-inspired meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, and garlic.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and sear the lamb until browned on all sides.
Transfer the lamb to a lacquerware bowl and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 180 degrees Celsius and continue roasting for 1 hour and 30 minutes.
While the lamb is roasting, prepare the vegetables by peeling and chopping the carrots and potatoes, and trimming the brussels sprouts.
Toss the vegetables in malt vinegar and olive oil, and spread them around the lamb in the lacquerware bowl.
Return the bowl to the oven and roast for an additional 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
